text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Vega Systems sent an invoice but there's no PO on the PDF. Amount $12,450. Vendor says this must clear EOM or they charge a late fee. PDF attached in thread.
Liam Ortiz: Can you paste the invoice ID and vendor reference?
Maya Chen: Invoice ID `VS-2026-0389`, vendor ref `99823`. Line items: Dedicated GPU hours, storage delta, cross-region egress.
Antonio Rivera: That amount looks like it should hit PO-7782 for EngPlatform. We used PO-5498 last year; vendor probably billed against the old PO.
Priya Sinha: I searched Coupa and can't find `PO-5498` (it's archived) and PO-7782 exists but vendor didn't reference it on the invoice.
FinanceBot: Automated alert: Invoice `VS-2026-0389` flagged — no PO match. Status: PAYMENT_HOLD.
Maya Chen: Vendor pressing for payment, says they'll do bank transfer if we can't do ACH. They asked for a one-time exception.
Antonio Rivera: One-time supplier exception is possible but needs VP-level sign-off + AP ticket. Also need cost center and GL mapping.
Priya Sinha: Requesting @Ava Li (EngPlatform) to confirm cost center and manager approval. Maya, can you upload the vendor email thread?
Maya Chen: Done — uploaded vendor email and screenshots. Suggested GL: `6002` / subaccount `42` in the AP comment.
Ava Li: Confirmed — this should charge EngPlatform cost center 220-EP. Vendor invoiced wrong PO. I approve a single-payment exception if FP&A signs off.
Liam Ortiz: If vendor can reissue an invoice referencing `PO-7782` that's ideal. If they can't, we escalate via AP ticket and approvals to bypass the PO match rule.
FinanceBot: AP ticket #AP-54231 created by Priya Sinha. Required approvers added: Ava Li, Josef R (FP&A). Please approve within 48h to avoid vendor late fee.
Priya Sinha: Kicking approvals now. @Josef R — can you take FP&A sign-off? :please:
Josef R: I've reviewed GL and cash plan. Approve one-time payment override. Please include note "vendor billed wrong PO; reissue requested" in AP ticket.
FinanceBot: Payment hold cleared after required approvals. Payment scheduled in next run: 2026-03-30.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll confirm with Vega Systems that payment is scheduled and ask them to reissue future invoices with `PO-7782`. :thumbsup:
Liam Ortiz: Moving to close — Priya, mark AP ticket resolved once payment posts.
Priya Sinha: Will do. Marking ticket for follow-up to ensure vendor updates invoice template.
